thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: P0 - inference-runtime-prod experiencing elevated 5xx rate (service: /v1/generate). Page routed to @alice and @bob. Please ack and triage.

alice: acked. jumping in — looking at dashboards now.

bob: on it. I see error rate spike at ~14:22 UTC. throwing up a temporary grafana link: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/inf-prod-errors

carol: any obvious deploys? deploy-bot: deploy to inference-runtime-prod completed 1718923200 by dave (commit: a1b2c3).

dave: rolling back is an option if we suspect the deploy, but let's confirm logs first.

alice: logs show repeated failures: "error: kvcache eviction failed - OOM" and also a ton of fast-retry 429s from our load-balancer. sample tail:```
2024-06-20T14:21:33Z ERROR inference runtime: kvcache eviction failed, id=xyz123, mem=98%
2024-06-20T14:21:34Z WARN lb: backend 10.2.4.5 returned 429
```

bob: interesting. error signature looks like mem pressure + upstream retries. Could be a kernel change on the node or an infra fluke. metrics show GPU memory usage peaking for a subset of pods.

alice: mitigation: scaling up dedicated-pool-3 by +2 replicas and nuking one suspect node (cordon + drain) to force pods onto other machines. kicking autoscaler.

dave: done scale request. nodes draining now. will monitor.

alice: customer-impact summary for now: small subset (~6%) of requests returning 5xx with higher latency; paid customers using dedicated pools might have had degraded throughput. Filing incident ticket: https://support.redwood/inc/2024-12345

product-support: FYI raised to CS - front-line notified top 5 affected tenants.

carol: follow-up: we have too many alerts firing during this event — alert noise made it hard to prioritize the kvcache OOM signature. we should tune.

sre-lead: agreed. post-mortem action items should include alert tuning and log-alert rule updates. capture quick wins here so we don't get paged for known transient behavior.

bob: current log-based alert rule (legacy) is:```
query: status:500 OR status:502 OR status:503 | count() by 1m > 10
```
This catches all 5xx bursts but is noisy (false positives during short LB flaps).

alice: propose we change to a more specific query that excludes retry-category 429/502 transient messages and looks for the kvcache OOM signature. Draft:```
query: (status:500 OR status:503) AND message:/kvcache eviction failed|OOM/ | stats count() by 5m > 3
```
That will only alert when we see the OOM text and sustained errors over 5 minutes.

bob: also add a negative-match to ignore known retry flood patterns:```
AND NOT message:/(lb.*429|retry-after)/
```
This should cut out the LB-induced noise.

carol: we should add a regex signature for the OOM stacktrace variant:```
regex: "kvcache eviction failed|out of memory|OOM killed process"
```
and map that to a new alert key: infra.inference.kvcache_oom.

alice: I'll open a PR to update the log-alert rule + create a Grafana panel. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/alerts/pulls/456 (WIP).

bob: for the metric-based alert, change threshold from 2% error-rate across cluster to 5% with 5m rolling avg for production routes — `infra-inference-error-rate-prod` -> new threshold config.

carol: add a dashboard panel showing error signature counts and broken down by pool (hosted/dedicated/private). name: "inference-runtime / error-signatures"

alice: action list (short):
- alice: PR to update log-alerts with regex + new alert key (in-flight)
- bob: update metric alert thresholds and add 5m rolling avg
- carol: create dashboard and add to SLO runbook pages
- dave: document node drain findings in the incident ticket

sre-lead: please also add a brief note in the runbook about when to temporarily silence the noisy rule during autoscaler events. we want rapid mitigation but not total silence.

product-support: customers updated. no escalations to legal.

deploy-bot: deploy rollback to inference-runtime-prod triggered by dave at 1718924100 (rollback commit: z9y8x7).

alice: after rollback + node drain + scale up we saw 5xx rate drop back to baseline around 14:48 UTC. marking mitigated. :white_check_mark:

bob: follow-up tasks assigned in ticket. will schedule alert tuning change for next maintenance window but plan to ship regex filter as low-risk hotfix to log-alerts today.

carol: note for the post-incident review: when we create regex filters, include test logs that would have matched / not matched to avoid accidental suppression. add unit tests to alert rules repo.

alice: summary to paste in postmortem: "Root cause: memory pressure on subset of inference nodes causing kvcache eviction errors; symptoms amplified by load balancer retry floods. Mitigations: node drain, scale-up, rollback. Long-term: alert tuning (log regex signatures), new dashboard, runbook updates."

sre-lead: thanks team. please update the incident ticket with the PR links and I'll schedule the RCA review tomorrow 16:00 UTC. :calendar:
